title: Daniyal Mansur, Founder and CEO of 22 Signals
description: Daniyal Mansur is the founder and CEO of 22 Signals, a global business solutions company based in London, working across AI, technology and growth.
intro: Daniyal Mansur is the founder and CEO of 22 Signals, a global business solutions company based in London. He sets the direction, works with clients and still builds some of the company's AI tools himself.

p: He started his first company, Salt Esports, at 17 and grew it to a million followers. He then helped run large live events, where the start time never moves. That habit stayed with him: every date 22 Signals agrees with a client goes in writing.
MSc in Business Analytics with Distinction from Queen Mary University of London, and a BBA from the Lahore School of Economics.
